newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials rise 50 points at open, curbs set.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials rise 50 points at open, curbs set.

text.p: The Dow industrials rose more than 50 points at the opening Thursday, and the New York Stock Exchange imposed index-arbitrage trading curbs at 0944 EDT/1344 GMT.
Analysts said the market was being boosted by a narrower-than-expected U.S. trade gap for April and a rise in new jobless claims.

The Dow was up 54.73 points at 7773.44, and the Nasdaq composite was up 5.51 to 1437.94. The 30-year U.S. Treasury bond was up 5/32 to yield 6.68 percent, and the Standard & Poor's 500 index added 4.76 points to 893.82.
